c:
Ah, a note on 'special cargo.' How delightfully subtle--about as discreet as a goblin's pyrotechnics.

It seems the Tideborne are entangled in this mess, and we have little choice but to wade in after them. If that means diving into the depths, so be it.
d:
The Sunwell's radiance may shine, but its Light has not purged the filth that festers within this city. Smugglers scuttle through the streets like vermin, preying upon the desperate and enriching the spineless.

Yet, there are whispers of something fouler still--trade in wares so vile that even the Venture Company would recoil. I require someone to spy on each shipping company and find out which cloaks a smuggling ring.

Will you stand with me, or will you turn away as the rot spreads?
obj: Investigate Shipping Companies in Fairbreeze Village.
Find a place to eavesdrop on Sunrun Salvage
Find a place to eavesdrop on Duskflight Exports
Find a place to eavesdrop on Tideborne Freight
Abandoned Note
p: So, what did our fine dockworkers have to say?

c:
Thank you. I think I've got a hold over my senses now.

It's so strange. Antenorian called me a child of the Light and yet...
d:
I need a moment, after what we just went through. I feel like my body is fighting with itself.

But we're in hostile territory. I can't let us fall to enemies just because I was... because I had to jump in after him. We need to keep Umbric safe.

Can you clear out the Twilight's Blade around us to give us some room to recover?
obj: Slay Twilight's Blade cultists in Speaker's Rest.
Twilight's Blade slain (12)
p: It's like one half of me is at war with the other half.

c:
We've shown everyone that Undermine ain't never bendin' the knee to no one. And if they try to force us, they better be ready for a hell of a fight.

The future ain't gonna be perfect--but if it's ours to mess up, that's good enough for me.
d:
We got one more thing to set straight.

Come on. Grimla's waitin' for us back in the hotel lobby.
obj: Speak to Grimla Fizzlecrank in the Incontinental Hotel.
Speak to Grimla
p: Heya, boss.

c:
A dog, a lynx, and now a ruined journal. Truly, I've seen lesser misfortunes in my day.

It seems the journal's fate was sealed long before we laid eyes on it. It is quite beyond saving. Once again, my faith in anything other than arcane precision has proven... misplaced.
d:
A dog, of all creatures? This is the thief we've been chasing?

And now we must save it from a lynx? Truly, this day has taken a most... irritating turn.

No matter, we shall retrieve the journal... though I do wonder if this canine truly understands the gravity of its actions.
obj: Defeat the Hot-Headed Lynx in the West Sanctum.
Hot-Headed Lynx slain
Chewed-Up Journal
p: Did you manage to retrieve the journal?

obj: Cave safeguarded (0/100%)

c:
Very well. The Void represents a threat to this world we cannot ignore.

I grow tired of yet another threat at the Sunwell that cannot be ignored.
d:
You have traveled far to ask my people to march to yet another war.

Maiev's fervor is blunt but not misplaced. While Silvermoon is under threat, let us not forget how many of my people burned when the sin'dorei failed to aid us at Teldrassil.

However, Bel'ameth stands tall thanks to their aid. Let each present their reasoning and I shall then make my decision.
obj: Have each envoy present their case to Shandris Feathermoon.
Hear Lor'themar's plea.
Hear Umbric's plea.
Hear Thalyssra's plea.
p: Have you more to add?

c:
Wow, you bigger and taller than kobold friends. Hello Big-Tall, my name Skibbles!

Me hear you are very brave, Big-Tall. Skibbles want to be just like you! Talk-Rock say you here to help Skibbles.

You here to take Skibbles on an adventure?? Me always want to go on adventure! Dis gonna be best day ever!
d:
Oh, hello! You must be <name>. I can't thank you enough for stopping by to help with these little ones. 

Since we earthen don't have children of our own, I thought it would be fun to help some of our allies out for the week, but it turns out children are quite... energetic. I also don't have a good grasp of what children find "fun" yet. 

If you could take the kobold youngling with you that would be helpful. They seem to have somewhere they want to visit. 

Take this whistle to call them to you.
obj: Speak to the orphan, Skibbles.

c: Compliments of the house! Take this to the nice Hobgoblin just across the way and pick yourself up somethin' nice.

obj: Morsel of Crab Meat (35)
Big Meaty Claw (5)
Expedition forces assisted (0/100%)

c: Those'll do. Nice work.
d:
Right then. We're gonna need tae collect things tae make the snakes comfortable on K'aresh. Let's get 'em some bedding.

Some of the most important things are rocks! Snakes can sun themselves atop a rock or hide under it.

Those nearby earth elementals were always a pain in our side. See if you can get some rocks from 'em.
obj: Collect 20 Smooth Stones from Tortured Earth Spirits, Enraged Crushers, or Shattered Rumblers.
Smooth Stone (20)
p:
It's nice to be helpin' these critters rather than hunting 'em.

The angry elementals don't count!

d:
Ah hello, <name>. I have a flier for you.

DON'T MISS OUT!!!

Don't miss this amazing deal available only to you! Present this coupon on your next purchase from your neighborhood endeavor trader, and get bonus items for free!

Coupon valid for one week. Terms and conditions apply.
obj: Purchase an item from an endeavor trader found in your neighborhood.
Buy an item from an endeavor trader

c:
Chicken soup is good for a lot of things. Dunno if the mouthwash'll help though.

At least they'll smell better?
d:
Black Blood? Nasty stuff. Glad I got this mask here. Nobody should be workin' in that mess. 

It gets inside ya, messes with ya head. Some folks get dizzy, seein' things that ain't there. Some even sproutin' strange scales. Makes me itch thinkin' about it. 

An' there ain't no cure. Best we can do is ease the pain an' maybe help the symptoms a bit. 

I got a "cure" brewin'. It's just soup, but they don't know that. 

It's almost "done," but it could use some flavor.
obj: Help Stitchoaf ease the goblin's symptoms in the Ringing Deeps.
Ingredients added (3)
"Cure" picked up
"Cure" applied to Incapacitated Miners (10)
p: I got the pot simmerin'. All it needs is a few finishing touches.

obj: Collect 6 K'arroc Eggs.
K'arroc Egg (6)
d:
I've been talkin' with the others about food for the snakes, an' we think we have a solution.

The k'arrocs have been prospering a wee bit too much for the ecology o' the Oasis. If ye get some o' their eggs, that should be enough for now so we can feed the snakes.
p: How goes the egg pilferin'?
c: How'd you carry 'em all? If I'd known, I would have given you some more o' them portation tag thingies.

obj: Gather 3 Feathers of Jan'alai from the cliffs behind the Temple of Jan'alai.
Feather of Jan'alai (3)
d:
De eggs are nearly ready!

Ya may know somethin' about dis, eh? Jan'alai tells me so. What ya lack in blood, ya make up for in spirit. Help me teach Shaja! Ya spirit alone is not enough for dis ritual. De eggs are imbued with de power of de loa herself and will burst with fiery energy!

We can protect ya from dis, but first we need feathers. Loa feathers! Collect dem from around de temple... unless ya dare ask de loa herself!
p: Ya got de feathers? Or are ya gonna melt?
c:
Ah ha! De feathers!

Dey will protect ya during de hatchin' ritual, but we must work a little magic on ya first. I taught Shaja the protection blessin' while you were runnin' about.

Do not worry! She is a natural.

obj: Shadow Infused Shard (6)
Subdue Void Creatures or Kill Players (0/100%)
Subdue Creatures or Kill Players (0/100%)
Kill Shadowguards or Kill Players (100)
Craft an antidote and cure the infected ren'dorei in the Molt.
Blood Petals mulled
Livers pulverized
Pathogen Antidote
Antidote administered
Ren'dorei Scout cured (6)
Riftwalker Lorn cured
d:
Let us hope we are able to concoct a cure from the reagents you acquired.

I have already prepared the base potion, but now we need to carefully mix in the blood petals and livers you procured. With some calculated determination and a bit of luck, we should be able to craft an antidote and administer it to the afflicted ren'dorei scouts nearby.

<name>, assist Blocciniux by mixing in the gathered ingredients.
p: Were you successful? Did the antidote work?
c:
Riftwalker Lorn is dead? This is troubling news. 

You have my gratitude for saving as many of the ren'dorei as you did.

obj: Return the Faceless Mask of Multitudes to the altar within a Horrific Vision.
Faceless Mask of Multitudes (quest item) (provided)
d: There are those enemies that you will battle or come into conflict over and over. Thought defeated they return from the shadows to attack you again and again. This is is the heart of a true nemesis. And, these are the enemies that will live on forever no matter what you do.
p: Place the Faceless Mask of Multitudes on the altar.
c: Satiated in the blood of multitudes now and forever. For our ranks will be endless and consume the world.

obj: Return the Faceless Mask of Vengeance to the altar within a Horrific Vision.
Faceless Mask of Vengeance (quest item) (provided)
d: Blood begets blood, and the weight of the fallen lingers in the air like a whispered curse. Those who stand witness to your wrath feel it creeping into their bones, driving them to strike harder, desperation masquerading as courage. Vengeance does not end violence. It only feeds the storm.
p: Place the Faceless Mask of Vengeance on the altar.
c: Be prepared to face the wrath of your enemies should you don this mask.

t: Faceless Mask of the Burned Bridge
obj: Return the Faceless Mask of the Burned Bridge to the altar within a Horrific Vision.
Faceless Mask of the Burned Bridge (quest item) (provided)
d: The displaced warrior is always on uneasy footing, especially one who is removed from her home world. The void makes this unsteadiness a reality where one step can lead into the abyss or drain you to your core.
p: Place the Faceless Mask of the Burned Bridge on the altar.
c: The treacherous path of the Burned Bridge will be available to you if you wish to tread it.

obj: Return the Faceless Mask of the Daredevil to the altar within a Horrific Vision.
Faceless Mask of the Daredevil (quest item) (provided)
d: The hunter never sought to lead yet sought a challenge in life at every turn. He directed his allies with a deft hand and never shied from diving in to the melee himself. The prowess he showed made him as well as my other minions much more deadly. Return this mask to the shrine of the Daredevil to challenge your own resolve in battle as your foes attacks cut even more deep.
p: Place the Faceless Mask of the Daredevil on the altar.
c: The path of the Daredevil is available to you if you dare.

t: Faceless Mask of the Dark Imagination
obj: Return the Faceless Mask of the Dark Imagination to the altar within a Horrific Vision.
Faceless Mask of Dark Imagination (quest item) (provided)
d: The magi, twisting their magic to manipulate and conquer the world. Imagining greater power they tread along the lines of the voids domain. In these pursuits this magi came to the realization that the in the depths of one's imagination lies truly dark and terrible things.
p: Place the Faceless Mask of the Dark Imagination on the altar.
c: The risks at the edges of your sanity will now manifest if you so choose to engage them.

t: Faceless Mask of the Long Night
obj: Return the Faceless Mask of the Long Night to the altar within a Horrific Vision.
Faceless Mask of the Long Night (quest item) (provided)
d: The endurance needed to make it this far is extraordinary and the feat of a long experienced adventurer. Yet, the longest night is nigh and with it our ultimate conquest. Those that fight the coming of eternal twilight know only futility, for in the Longest Night they will be on the edge of sanity forever.
p: Place the Faceless Mask of the Long Night on the altar.
c: Taking a step towards the Longest Night is already acknowledging the sanity you have lost. Do you risk the rest on such a fools errand?

obj: Return the Faceless Mask of the Nemesis to the altar within a Horrific Vision.
Faceless Mask of the Nemesis (quest item) (provided)
d: There are those enemies that you will battle or come into conflict over and over. Thought defeated they return from the shadows to attack you again and again. This is is the heart of a true nemesis. And, these are the enemies that will live on forever no matter what you do.
p: Place the Faceless Mask of the Nemesis on the altar.
c: Acknowledging your nemesis is the first step towards their final defeat. Yet, they would not be a nemesis if they did not find infinite ways to face you again and again.

obj: Return the Faceless Mask of the Pained to the altar within a Horrific Vision.
Faceless Mask of the Pained (quest item) (provided)
d: Trading in secrets, trading in lies, operating on the fringes are all the Spymaster knows. His lost passions, lost loves are all gone, crushed under his own duty and loyalty to the crown. Nothing is left, nothing but the pain. Pain is an apt tutor and tool and one in which the void knows intimately. Return my mask if you dare to feel the many forms pain can take.
p: Place the Faceless Mask of the Pained on the altar.
c: As my madness and torment is not enough, feel free to invite even more pain in the future.

obj: Kill 8 encroaching wildlife.
Encroaching wildlife slain (8)
d:
This sanctum was studying the Lightbloom well before the incident at Fairbreeze. We had no reason to be concerned over their research up until that point.

However, the last message we attempted to send never received a reply. And this doesn't look good now that we're here.

We need to clear out some of the wildlife first, though. We cannot risk any contamination.
p: How goes the hunt?
c:
It's an unfortunate task, but the creatures did not belong here. They would have put any new researchers at risk.

Now to the actual problem.

obj: Teach the Thorntail Matriarch to hunt Lapbug Skitterers 10 times.
Thorntail Matriarch retrieved
Lapbug Skitterers hunted (10)
d:
The thorntails aren't hunting like they're supposed tae?

Ve'nari said that lapbugs aren't their normal prey. We'll need to teach the matriarch how to hunt them ourselves!
p: Is she hunting properly?
c: If you told a younger me I'd be teaching animals how to hunt, I'd have laughed you away.
You want that to go? Have it your way!

obj: Choose an ally of the , , , or Shades of the Row to invite to Saltheril's Soiree this week.
Your choice will determine which faction will offer "Fortify the Runestones" to your Warband this week.
Invitation selected
d:
Ah, <name>, my favorite <class>! I am delighted to see you in attendance once more.

You have quite the natural talent for these sorts of affairs. The nobles are pleased with your presence and your favor has been swaying their coffers.

Let us not stop a good thing, shall we? Help me choose an ally of our representatives to invite to the Haven this week. I'm ever curious to see the drama you will stir up.

As my personal guest of honor, your favor will be seen as an extension of my favor.
p: Be cautious, as always. The sin'dorei take great offense to many subtle things.
c:
Excellent choice.

I will have my valet send for them at once.

obj: Learn where to obtain Decor.
Visit merchants selling local decor
Visit merchants selling flora decor
Visit merchants selling elven decor
Ask the Last Architect about other decor sources
Visit the smugglers
Buy Sethraliss Priest's Pillow
Add Sethraliss Priest's Pillow to House Chest
d: A house isn't quite a home without the perfect furnishings. It looked like there were some vendors in town. Perhaps it would be worth checking what they have in stock.
p: Have you met all the local vendors? They have some great furnishings available.
c: Did you find any good pieces for your house? We hope to have more vendors visit in the future, so be sure to check back often!

obj: Speak to Liadrin at the Sunwell.
Check in with Liadrin at the Sunwell
Speak with Commander Koruth Mountainfist
Receive a blessing from War Chaplain Senn
Spar with Commander Venel Lightblood
d:
Champion, the Sunwell holds for now, but the Vanguard has begun to deploy the bulk of its forces to Voidstorm.

Lady Liadrin has requested your assistance at the Sunwell.
p: It's heartening to see our commanders so eager to bring the fight to the enemy.
c: We persevere for now, <name>. The quicker we face Xal'atath at the Voidspire, the quicker this can all be behind us.

obj: Catalyze the Hungering Oblivium with violence by defeating Midnight Season 1 raid bosses or completing Mythic+ dungeons and Bountiful Delves to continue forging the Nilhammer.
The Nilhammer will allow you to use Ascendant Voidcores to increase the item level of worthy weapons and trinkets.
Hungering Oblivium catalyzed (3)
Hungering Oblivium (provided)
d: Our nascent Nilhammer coalesces! But I will need to weave the Void energies from more Hungering Oblivium into it before it can fully take form. Luckily I have prepared another piece for you to catalyze. Extreme violence, remember?
c: Ah, well done. Another successful Oblivium catalyzation. The Nilhammer grows stronger!

obj: Win Battlegrounds in Training Grounds or against players.
Battlegrounds won (2)
d: This is the final week of training. Take all of the lessons you've learned and put them into practice in the Training Grounds or against other players. Once complete, speak with Captain Dawnrunner in Falconwing Square.
p: You have yet to finish your training for the week.
c: Well done completing the training program. For your hard work, take this! As you continue your journeys in battle, you can return back to me to become better equipped.

obj: Ride the War Eagle
Bone Cages destroyed (10)
Children of Ula'tek slain (20)
Eggs burned (30)
Serpents slain (12)

c:
Not everyone would go to such lengths for these creatures.

I'd like to give you something special, as thanks for your help. I I think think you y have more than proven you can be entrusted with this.

A hawkstrider egg. Not yet hatched, but there is a little one in there--wiggling. curious, and eager to meet the one who will raise it with love. Take care of it, and it will take good care of you in return.

obj: Complete the Nightfall scenario.
Complete the scenario "Nightfall"
d:
Sureki forces are gathering all over Hallowfall and Azj-Kahet--but we're certain they're just distractions. 

We think the main attack will come from the west. When the time comes we'll need all the help we can get to push them back and defend Mereldar. 

Can Flame's Radiance count on your support?
p: Be ready, the Sureki could attack at any moment!
c: I knew we could count on you!

;Renown 2
Your exemplary service hasn't gone unnoticed, <name>. I hope this reward serves you well.

;Renown 3 onwards
Your service has not gone unnoticed, <name>. I hope this reward serves you well.

obj: Document 7 Domineering K'arrocs.
Domineering K'arrocs documented (7)
Appropriated Azerothian Camera (provided)
d: We are in need of new photos of the k'arrocs for our records. Please take some for us while you are out in the eco-dome.
c: Excellent. You show much talent for image capturing. Thank you.

obj: Shrink and collect 8 Domineering K'arrocs.
Domineering K'arrocs shrunk and collected (8)
Condenser Disc (provided)
d:
There is much medical data to be gleaned in the evaluation of the k'arrocs.

Please take the condenser disc to shrink them and then pick the little ones up for easy transport.
p: How is the shrinking and collecting coming along?
c: Thank you again. These k'arrocs will do quite nicely.

obj: Confront the Sunreavers with Vereesa Windrunner at the gates of Silvermoon.
Meet Vereesa at the gate of Silvermoon
Negotiate with Aethas Sunreaver
d:
It is time for us to return to Silvermoon. I have no doubt we will be greeted as traitors and murderers.

I do not care how we are seen. I care that Quel'Thalas survives.

Will you join us, <name>?

From what Arator has said, you have earned more than a measure of respect from Silvermoon. I would be honored if you would assist us in entering the city without incident.
c:
Thank you, <name>.

Now let's begin planning this city's defense before it is too late. Again.

obj: Jump on a Bouncy Mushroom
Mana Spore (5)
Collect 10 Thorntail Essences while Phase Diving in Untethered Space on K'aresh.
Untethered Space entered (Optional)
Thorntail Essence (10)
d:
You have done well with the slatebacks. Will you do as well with the thorntails?

If we are to improve their numbers, we will need some of their astral essence to produce new ones. Procure it for me.
p: Do you have the essences?
c: You are reliable, as always.

obj: Challenge and defeat the Thorntail Matriarch.
Thorntail Matriarch defeated
d:
Your efforts in teaching the matriarch to hunt have been too effective, it seems. Several broker guards have been attacked recently. 

Since you caused this issue, I need you to solve it. Best the thorntail matriarch in a fight. The rest of the thorntails will back down once their leader is humbled.
p: Have you made a suitable display of dominance?
c: I knew you would be effective in this situation. I did not know it would be such a pleasure to watch you accomplish your task.

obj: Spider Eggs destroyed (20)
Collect 35 Rocks in your neighborhood.
Talk to Shajanji (Optional)
Collect 30 Rocks (35)
Slightly Magical Crystal Locator
d:
Ya be down for helping me out with a little spot of bother?

Shajanji be over in the mountains collecting some local rocks. If you could go help her out, I'd be mighty grateful ta ya. Just bring them back ta me. I be keeping them safe for her.

I--She needs a lot of them. She be an avid collector.
p: Did ya help out Shajanji?
c:
Oh yah, I can use these--I mean Shajanji will be happy with these in her collection.

Ya did good.

obj: Collect 6 fillet and 4 jelly in Harandar.
Frillfish Fillet (6)
Root Drift Jelly (4)
Yu'relen's Elixir drunk (Optional)
d:
Age has caught up with me this morning and I have pulled something.

Still, our village meal must still be prepared. Otherwise, it will mean the loss of much more than just an empty stomach.

If you would gather some ingredients for the meal, your aid would not go unappreciated.
p: I hope you brought back a good harvest.
c: Excellent. Even an old cook can work wonders with good hands beside him.

obj: Help Ve'nari use her machine to create life in the Oasis.
Insert the K'arroc Essence into the Oasis Console
K'arroc created
d:
We have only to let the machine do its work now. 

I will let you do the honors. If it fails, I will place the blame on you...

... I jest, my friend. Mostly.
c: A success... Do you understand what this means, <name>? We are no longer limited to the creatures we took with us. So long as we can find their untethered counterparts, we can remake any of K'aresh's creatures. They will live again!

obj: Slay 10 monsters in Pillar-nest Vosh.
Pillar-nest Vosh monsters slain (10)
d:
I'm sending you somewhere a lil scary, but I'm sure you can handle anything that comes your way!

Mind clearing up some of the creatures so it'll be easier for Gharrli to gets the ingredients in the future?
p: Did ya get 'em?
c:
I get along fine with nerubians, but those things...

Those things scare me. Glad they're gone. Phew!

obj: Vacuum up 20 Honey Bees to K'aresh while in Rosaline's Apiary in Stormsong Valley on Azeroth.
Honey Bees vacuumed (20)
Take the portal back to the Oasis
Return to the Oasis
Anima Vacuum (provided)
d: I seem to bee running low on bee puns at the moment, but I do need more bees from Stormsong Valley. Would you bee a dear and collect them for me?
c: As always, your assistance is appreciated. What? I can't drop puns every time, you know.

obj: Collect 12 pieces of litter and use the G.O.L.E.M.'s incinerator function to dispose of them.
Garbage disposed (12)
d:
My old man's got all these crazy ideas about helping the world... I dunno. It's all a bit over my head, but I guess that's why I was never the inventor he wanted me to be.

Still, I've got some thoughts on how to solve problems around here. Like those dang rodents getting litter all over the streets!

It might not revitalize the spirit of the community or whatever, but I bet people would be happier if we cleaned up the streets.
p: Toxic fumes? Nah, that's just what Undermine smells like!
c: The place is looking cleaner already! Maybe there's something to this G.O.L.E.M. thing.

obj: Find a magical construct and retrieve its core.
Humming Core
d:
The sanctum door seems to be locked. Probably from the inside.

I believe an arcane construct is used for heavy lifting and general upkeep alongside the treants. The core of it should override the lock on the door and work as a master key. I doubt it will just let us take it, so be careful.
p: Yes?
c: Perfect. This should get us inside the main building.

obj: Complete any Delve.
Delve Completed
d:
Hello? Hello? You're back! Perfect!

I was studying the titan console and gathering a bunch of new information from the overcharged areas including the faulty directives that were found. This might be the key to this unexpected behavior, but I'll need more time tae know for sure.

Return to the delves and we can check the results of the faulty directives, I can use the information to create an upgrade for yer belt!
p: Were ye successful?
c:
Here, yes... With that information I can make some final tweaks. And adding this directive...

Ah! That should do it. If you insert this into yer durable information storage container, it should update the effectiveness of the device's, um... effects.

obj: Dehydrated Troll Eye Necklace (8)
Seal Legion Portals around Dalaran.
Legion Portal Sealed (2)
d:
Khadgar is close to divining the source of the Legion presence here, but there is no guarantee that he will if the Legion's plans proceed unchallenged. The fate of Dalaran is not yet decided. All he needs is a little more time.

You can buy him that time by halting the Legion's efforts here in the city.

Seek out Legion Portals and seal them. That should slow the arrival of more demons entering the city.
p: Sealing those Legion portals will slow them down considerably.
c:
I can sense the power emanating from your artifact from here. Good.

I've also noted that it hasn't fractured under the power load yet. Also good.

Let me just make a note of that for Moratari's records. Very good.

obj: Inoculate 5 Calmed Necrorays.
Calmed Necrorays inoculated (5)
d:
If these rays are to travel, we should inoculate them first.

What a good opportunity for you to learn about administering anti-plague, apprentice! It's not something that happens here very often.
p: Have you jabbed the necrorays?
c: I'm glad you were here, apprentice. I find wiping out all the plague in a creature quite unnerving. Feels very unhealthy.

obj: Contribute 10 times to events on the Siren Isle Command Map and complete one event by slaying the target.
Contribute ten times to events (10)
Complete an event triggered by the Siren Isle Command Map
d:
You. Do that again. Could be good stuff we ain't seen yet.

Get those caves open an' see what's in there!
p: Did you check out the cave? No? Get goin' then!
c: Dat was pretty easy. We should do more!

obj: Collect 10 Slateback Essence in the Untethered Space of K'aresh.
Speak with Hemet Nesingwary (Optional)
Untethered Space entered (Optional)
Slateback Essence (10)
d:
I have been working on the the Oasis console and I believe I am ready for the next step. It will involve destruction, so naturally I thought of you. 

I need you to use a phase conduit to shift into the Untethered Space of K'aresh and retrieve the essence of the ghostly slatebacks. I will explain more when you return.
p: Well? Have you succeeded?
c:
Excellent. 

Now, we raise the dead.

obj: Complete a neighborhood postal route.
Route selected
Postal route completed
d:
With so many new residents, mail in the neighborhoods is really starting to pile up. So many routes and just one of me! If only I could deputize an assistant mail carrier...

Say, <name>, would you be willing to help out? I've got some juicy parcels from the dead letter office I could offer in thanks.
p: Neither scourge nor fel nor void nor dragon's flame shall stay we couriers from the swift delivery of our entrusted missives!
c: You're a lifesaver! And we're certain none of those letters or packages ended up in a ditch somewhere, right?

obj: Collect 7 Vibrant Crownfeathers in the Serpent's Tail.
Vibrant Crownfeather (7)
d:
The final piece of Captain Tokka's hydra lure are feathers from the Children of Ula'tek themselves.

Ssak'mozek is trained to listen to the orders of these monsters. It lies in wait for them to call it from the murky depths. The lure can't work without something tying it to Ssak'mozek's masters.

Any of the children at the Gate of the Eastern Fang will have feathers perfect for the lure. Bring as many as you can.
p: Do you have the last piece of Ssak'mozek's lure? We need feathers--the brighter, the better.
c: That's everything we need. I'll craft the lure. Next, we take down that monster!

t: Guardians of Death, Guardians in Stone
obj: Search for the long dead owner of this gem.
Amani warrior statue found
Med'jai Medallion reunited with statue
Plaque examined (Optional)
Suggested players: 2
d:
In de legends passed down, dey speak of a group of heroic guardians whose sacrifice protect us to dis day. These honored few, known as de Med'jai, adorned their belts with gems like these--de better to draw their enemies in and defeat dem.

We were told dey went on a great expedition to fight de evil abroad, but it seems de greatest of de evils was within--below our feet.

Please, <name>, search for dis gem's true home. If our ancestor spirits watch over us, perhaps we will find their resting place.
c:
I see much has changed, gokinye.

As a warrior, I fought for de Amani on de field of battle. My blade was feared amongst our enemies.

When my people asked for me to watch over dis temple, I was de first to step forward. There is no greater honor than to give your life for your people. And I am proud to do it.

But looking around, I wonder. Was our sacrifice in vain?

obj: Report to Zo'ropo at Shadow Point.
d: We've progressed further in our infiltration of the Manaforge's defenses. Return to HQ and I'll clear you for access.
c: We found a weakness in Forgeweaver Araz's engineering bay that should allow you access to another console nearby. Keep up the pressure, and we'll let you know once the whole facility is ours. Happy hunting.

obj: Report to Zo'ropo at Shadow Point.
d: Our saboteurs have made great progress on hacking Omega's security systems; swing by and let me tell you about what we've learned.
c: There are consoles inside the Manaforge that keep the flow of energy running smoothly within the facility. We've cracked security on the first set of them, allowing you to turn the tables on enemies near Loom'ithar and Soulbinder Naazindrhi. You'll only be able to use one, but sabotaging them should allow you an edge in battle. Good luck in there.

obj: Report to Zo'ropo at Shadow Point.
d: Hero... we're in. We have full control of Manaforge Omega's security. I'll brief you on your next trip back.
c: Manaforge Omega's security systems are under our direct control. Thanks to the damage you've done in there, we can get you access to consoles extending all the way to Salhadaar, and whatever lies beyond. We've also ensured you can use every console you come across. That's all I can do for you. Get in there and finish the fight.

obj: Defeat the Behemoth Petalwing in Harandar.
Behemoth Petalwing slain
d:
That's the one! The big one! The one that took him!

We didn't stop it before. But this time, we will. We are haranir. And haranir never back down. Haranir never give up.

We're bringing him back. And we're ending this. Are you with me?
c:
Thank you so much for rescuing me... not that I needed it of course. Anyway, you seem to be pretty good yourself. So after talking with everyone, we all agreed to make you a part of our group!

Be proud. This is an honor only few have received, but you've earned every bit. You are officially one of us! Be proud, stand tall, and never give up!

obj: Collect 10 Void-Infused Morsels and 6 Glaring Glowcaps outside of the Howling Ridge.
Void-Infused Morsel (10)
Glaring Glowcap (6)
d:
You... make yourself useful.

As a master of terrible beasts, it is my job to mold these hatchlings into dreaded beasts. I pit them against each other and they grow ever more violent.

But the elves here insist that I will yield better results with just a bit of... tender loving care. Let us put this to the test.

This runt is Fidoficus. You will show him tenderness and affection, and then we will see how ferocious he becomes.

Collect some delicious dietary treats for him and return to me.
p: These ingredients will make for a highly nutritious and equally delectable meal.
c:
Fidoficus will be renowned for his ferocity.

I can see the violence growing in him.

One day, he will be a worthy pet for a domanaar such as myself.

obj: Defeat Forgeweaver Araz inside Manaforge Omega on any difficulty.
d: My friend, I hope your assault is going well. It's time for you to dispatch the Forgeweaver; using his mastery of technomancy he oversees both the Manaforge's production pipelines... as well as the ritual to return Dimensius to this plane. His workshop will be further in and heavily guarded, but cutting him down should stop their plans of resurrection for good.
p: Does the Forgeweaver yet live?
c: <Name>... I should have seen that coming. His devotion to Dimensius knew no bounds, and he certainly had contingencies in place to make sure the ritual would be completed. We'll have to attack from another angle. We found some debris from his inner sanctum that made its way here - if you have the skill, we can teach you how to use it for your own ends.

t: Head Hunting: Horrors of the Forge
obj: Defeat powerful Elite enemies within Manaforge Omega on any difficulty.
The Bone Melter slain
Darkmage Zadus slain
Enforcer Jak'tull slain
Watcher Gaz'Kreth slain
d: By now no doubt you've seen some of the Manaforge's Elite coming to Salhadaar's aid. I'm sending you a list of names now - focus on these targets, and you may uncover spoils to aid your assault.
p: Have you eliminated your targets?
c: Nicely done, champion. The resources they were hoarding will find a much better home with your companions.

obj: Defeat Loom'ithar within Manaforge Omega on difficulty.
Defeat Loom'ithar in the Manaforge Omega raid on difficulty or higher.
d: Our intelligence describes a colossal beast within the Manaforge, responsible for producing the fabric that gives the Shadowguard their very form. Take it down and we'll hinder their ability to produce reinforcements. Oh, and Ba'choso says to bring some of the silk back with you - he may be able to fashion it into something useful.
p: Have you procured a sample?
c: Its quality is unlike anything I've ever seen! I'll get to work right away. Now, let's discuss your payment.

obj: Defeat Nexus-King Salhadaar inside Manaforge Omega on any difficulty.
d: The hour of Salhadaar's demise is upon us. While he may posture upon his Voidwing, he grows desperate at the feet of the All-Devouring. The army he commands is not enough for your might - strike him down.
p: Strike swiftly, champion. Do not let Salhadaar escape justice.
c: Though not the end he deserved, we will celebrate his defeat nonetheless. See Zo'ropo to trade for a well-deserved reward. You have my eternal gratitude for deposing him.

obj: Defeat The Soul Hunters within Manaforge Omega on any difficulty.
d: Careful in the wastes, my friend. Scouts report that a trio of Demon Hunters are training south of the Manaforge - with one of them exhibiting power like we've never seen. You can avoid their path if you wish, but ignoring them could open you up to being flanked should they decide to engage. I recommend taking them out if you can, as well as providing us some samples of their newfound strength.
p: How fares your battle with the interlopers?
c: Soul energy like I've never seen it. While we cannot return them to the way they were, I believe you can use these runes to empower yourself even *through* death. Take them with you, and use them wisely.

obj: Arrived at the Heaps
Heaps enemies defeated (0/100%)
Approach your front door and enter your new house.
Enter your house via the front door
d: It's time to cross the threshold into a new chapter.
c: Make yourself at home!

obj: Complete various activities in Midnight zones.
Complete World Quests, Dungeons, and Delves in Midnight zones (10)
d:
I can't imagine what will happen to Quel'Thalas if the Sunwell falls to the forces of the Void.

We need you out on the battlefield, <name>. Bring hope and heroism to the people across these lands.
p: You must fight, <name>.
c: Well done, <name>!

obj: Gather with at least four other players inside a player home while the homeowner is present.
Host or attend a gathering in a player home
Suggested players: 5
d:
Kirin Tor scholars have argued for centuries over the semantics of a "gathering".

How many people are required? For how long must they remain? Who is bringing the beverages?

Debates have raged into the night. Papers written. Research grants awarded.

Consensus yet eludes the scholars, but they still meet often to deliberate. They take turns bringing beverages.
c: "Time spent with good company is time spent optimally" - Conjurer Margoss

obj: Look for Hemet Nesingwary in the Azure Span on the Dragon Isles.
Take the portal to the Azure Span (Optional)
Speak with Ve'nari (Optional)
Hemet Nesingwary found
d:
I am growing concerned that we may be in danger of overbalancing the ecosystem. We require a consultant. 

Have you read "The Green Hills of Stranglethorn?" I enjoyed it a great deal. The author appears to have turned from hunter to conservationist. Do not ask how I acquired this information. 

However, these are precisely the two skills I need. Retrieve him. Last I heard, he was in the Azure Span on the Dragon Isles. Use the portal to travel there.
c: If ye need my help, I need yours first.

obj: Gather 15 Rancor Essences.
Rancor Essence (15)
d:
It's good you are here, apprentice! I came to gather the essences from the local rancor. They are wonderful for adding just that little extra spice to a plague.

But now that you are here, I can have you gather them instead! What an excellent learning opportunity for you!
p: Well? Have you gathered the essences?
c: What an excellent apprentice you are!

obj: Clean 25 Congealed Lumps in the Oasis.
Congealed Lumps cleaned (25)
Anima Vacuum (provided)
d: It seems our custodians have been lax in their duties once again. Take the vacuum device. Clean up the lumps. I will cut you a percentage of the returns.
p: How go your efforts?
c: You never disappoint, <name>. Mostly. As promised, here is your cut.

obj: Stage 1 - Group Event
Stage 2 - Group Event Rare Spawn
Suggested players: 5
Collect 5 Felslate, 3 Chaotic Spinel and an Unbending Potion. These can be gathered and crafted using profession skills or purchased on the Auction House.
Felslate (5)
Chaotic Spinel (3)
Unbending Potion
d:
If we wish to achieve a sustained connection to Xoroth, we'll need a particularly resilient portal. Unfortunately, we can't just summon this one up from the ground.

I will need you to gather the requisite materials. Once we have them, I will have the mo'arg begin construction at once.

Here's the list of what you'll need.
p: Have you the necessary materials?
c:
Excellent. This Unbending Potion should shore up the Felslate enough to hold the portal's structure, and these Chaotic Spinel crystals should focus the portal's magic nicely.

I will set the mo'arg to work posthaste.

obj: Gas Collector filled
Gather 8 Luminous Fibers from creatures near Lightbloom Ath'Ran.
Luminous Fibers (8)
d:
I share our dear Saltheril's love for vintage fixtures, but the lighting enchantment he is using is far too common for such an auspicious occasion.

My Magisters can create a far more stunning enchantment. Simply gather some fibers from the Lightbloom for me and I can have them broken down into spell reagents.

The effect will be marvelous.
p: We need only a small quantity. Our spellwork is quite efficient.
c: Well done, my dear. We shall have the Haven sparkling in due time.

obj: Forge infinite bronze.
Arrived at Tanks for Everything
Anchor materials prepared
Temporal fibers separated
Anchoring materials infused
Infinite Bronze forged
d:
Now that we have the stabilizing materials and the frayed threads we can get to work.

I am, however, forbidden from directly interacting with this timeline. So, you'll need to be my hands. Not to worry, nothing forbids me from giving you some guidance.

Head next door to the forge inside Tanks for Everything and we'll get to work.
p: Infinite bronze, a material loaded with potential.
c:
Now that you have infinite bronze we can get you an artifact in order to properly carry out our tests.

Then you'll have no problem living up to your own legend, <name>.

obj: Tour the Infinite Bazaar.
Meet Nostwin
Meet Momentus, again
Meet Horos
Meet Hemet
Meet Larah
Meet Pythagorus
d:
There, Dalaran is back to how it should be.

I'm sure you have many questions, <name>. Who are we? What are we doing here? Why are you here?

The simple answer is this: We are the Infinite, we are searching through time for answers to questions larger than any of us, and we need your help to do it.

I think you will come to understand this answer more if you meet the rest of our flight. Moratari, if you would make the introductions?
p: As their name would suggest, the infinite dragonflight is certainly not lacking in numbers.
c:
As you can see, <name>, there are many minds at work here in the infinite dragonflight. Minds that are all working to answer some pressing questions.

What knowledge can we gain to prepare us for even greater threats?

Would we have triumphed if things had been worse?

What are the implications of Sargeras's sword being plunged into Azeroth, and was it the artifacts that saved Azeroth or something else?

Er, I mean... Forget I said anything. What sword?

<Name>, you have been an excellent assistant with our research. I think you deserve a promotion.

From now on, you will be able to take on more research assignments simultaneously.

It's ironic, isn't it, that we never seem to have enough time. Make good use of your time here. Don't make me regret granting you this power.

This will be a comprehensive study, so feel free to fight whatever you wish so that we can get a baseline understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.

obj: Interact with the Portal to Horrific Visions to rediscover the horrors of the Black Blood.
Portal to Horrific Visions used
Speak to the Image of Wrathion
Displaced Corrupted Mementos (20)
d:
Are you prepared?

The path through the timeways has been opened to where we last entered the visions.

Expect your sanity to be tested. You probably will not last long on this first attempt.

The portal is ready for you, <name>. Journey forth.
p: We must build on our past knowledge. Did you find something new?
c:
It's alright, <name>. You are back. You've done well. Remember, this was just a memory of a vision.

While we will keep you safe from the past, the danger we are all in from the Void is still very real in the present.

obj: Slay Twilight Imposter Gulkat in the Darkway Delve.
Enter the Darkway
Infiltrator Gulkat slain
d:
Ulen's imposter may have escaped, but I suspect I know what the cult has been doing.

The Twilight's Blade must be redirecting Suramar's mana flow. Without it being sent to the correct places, our awareness dulls, our golems wilt, and our entire society risks a mana withdrawal.

There is only one place they would be able to exert control over our ley lines like this, and that would be the Arcway.

Go. Find them and crush them.

We will meet in Silvermoon when you are done.
c:
Well done, champion.

Our golems are coming back online, our soldiers are able to conjure and power their weapons again, and we are mobilizing for war.

obj: Stop the Chief and recover the false gifts.
Groffa the Guzzler slain
Groffa's Treasures
d:
We gotta be brave to resist the Chief. We haven't been so brave and this got really bad.

If Chief Groffa is leading the tribe into the dark, he needs to be stopped. I think he's got trinkets in his stash, far more than he's given to the tribe. Stop him and find out what he's hiding!
p: What is he hoarding in his camp?
c:
The bag feels... tempting. I don't like it!

Good he kept this away from others, but also very bad for him.

obj: Portal Hub disrupted (0/100%)
Document 7 Domineering K'arrocs.
Domineering K'arrocs documented (7)

d:
We must keep our documentation updated. That means I require your services once more. 

Take this camera and gather more photos of the k'arrocs. You'll find them on the rocks around the area.
p: Have you taken the photos I requested?
c: These are exquisite, and will do quite nicely for our research. Thank you.

obj: Swirling Ectoplasm (10) (Optional)
Ki'clak Snack obtained
Ki'clak fed
Collect 4 Fallen Branches around Kan'sha in the Solemn Valley.
Fallen Branch of Kan'sha (4)
d:
Next, we need to collect de logs for our bonfire. Kan'sha, de large tree at de end of de valley, was infected with poison from a stray arrow long ago.

She's quite tough. To survive, she sheds her branches regularly.

In a way, Kan'sha has become a regular part of our rituals. Her strong wood burns warm and hot--like Amani blood.

It is perfect for bonfires.
p: Do not worry for Kan'sha. She has outlived generations of trolls, and de druids say she'll survive many more.
c:
Kan'sha's been a long-time friend, and I spend many of my nights restin' here under her pines when I can't go home.

Our tribe warns folks to be watchin' for her falling branches, but dey never hit me. Not one scar or bruise came from her.

c: Excellent. I shall take it from here.

Why don't you make that happen, hmm?

obj: Meet up with Umbric in Shand'orah in K'aresh.
Portal Taken to K'aresh (Optional)
Umbric reached in Shan'dorah
d:
;Magister Umbric
If you have the time to visit K'aresh, I could use your help locating my wayward apprentice, Leona.

She's been researching ways for the ren'dorei to harness the void beyond the methods we currently employ. She's identified a curious, if tenuous parallel between how demon hunters wield the fel and how we might be able to leverage those lessons to our own ends.

I'm in K'aresh often, but I can't be everywhere at once. Can you assist?

;Messenger Aelor
Ah, you're there!

Our esteemed Magister Umbric has tasked me with wrangling an able-bodied champion to assist him. An apprentice of his, Leona Darkstrider, is investigating the techniques and methods of the illidari.

It appears her inquiries may have put her in a bit of trouble.

The Magister can fill you in. He's in K'aresh now, and he's allowed me to open the way for you if you require transportation.
c: I'm glad you've chosen to join me here, <name>.

obj: Meet Botanist Alaenra at the Oasis.
